# Pandit Ji Express

> Verified North Indian Vedic Pandit & Purohit Services in Bangalore with Doorstep Samagri

Pandit Ji Express provides authentic Vedic ceremonies conducted by verified, Hindi-speaking scholars across Bengaluru. Ceremonies include Griha Pravesh, Vedic Vivah (Weddings), Hawan/Yagya, Satyanarayan Katha, and traditional Sanskars.

## Sacred Ceremonies & Puja Services
- [Griha Pravesh Puja Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/griha-pravesh-pooja-bangalore.html): Complete housewarming ceremony with Vastu Shanti, Navagraha Havan, and Kalash Sthapana.
- [Wedding Pandit in Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/wedding-pandit-bangalore.html): Authentic North Indian Vedic Vivah Sanskar, Kanyadaan, Saptapadi, and Sindoor Vidhi.
- [Satyanarayan Katha Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/satyanarayan-puja-bangalore.html): Sacred narrative of Lord Vishnu with authentic Panchamrit and prasad preparation.
- [Hawan & Yagna in Bangalore](https://panditjiexpress.in/havan-yagna-bangalore.html): Purification fire rituals including Maha Ganapati, Navchandi, and Gayatri Havan.
- [Vedic Pooja Services](https://panditjiexpress.in/services.html): Complete directory of 16+ traditional Vedic ceremonies and pujas.
